goal: Bootstrap the dau-viet-admin Next.js + TypeScript CMS foundation: real admin authentication against the Spring Boot /api/v1 auth contract (login, refresh rotation, logout, CONTENT_ADMIN authorization), reusable responsive Admin shell (sidebar/header/breadcrumbs), dashboard and honest module entry shells (events, lessons, evidence/assets, templates, versions), typed API client layer with TanStack Query, Vietnamese design-system components, automated tests incl. one browser-level Login->Dashboard test, CI job, and harness registration — without implementing the full Lesson Builder.

acceptanceCriteria.text: dau-viet-admin Next.js App Router + strict TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + TanStack Query + React Hook Form/Zod initialized; pinned lockfile; ESLint, type-check, env validation, import aliases, dev and production build configured.
Real admin authentication: email/password login posts to POST /api/v1/auth/login; no mock auth; validation + meaningful error messages; logout calls POST /api/v1/auth/logout and clears session.

Session handling is safe: refresh token never in localStorage; secure HttpOnly cookie / server-side BFF session where practical; access-token expiry handled via POST /api/v1/auth/refresh rotation; authenticated state restored after page reload; redirect URLs validated.

Authorization: users without CONTENT_ADMIN role cannot reach protected admin functionality; unauthenticated users redirected to /login; learner JWT gets denied UX (backend still enforces hasRole CONTENT_ADMIN on /api/v1/admin/**).

Admin Layout per ADMIN_SCREEN_DESIGN.md: sidebar navigation, top header, breadcrumbs, current admin identity, logout, collapsible sidebar, mobile/narrow navigation, loading/error boundaries, not-found and forbidden states; working pages distinguished from coming-soon modules.
Screens A-01 Login and A-02 Dashboard implemented; dashboard shows welcome/header, quick navigation to content modules and only backend-supported summary info (no fabricated metrics).

Reusable design system per ART_DIRECTION/UI_COMPONENT_SPEC: buttons, inputs, labels/field errors, cards, status chips, table+pagination shell, confirm dialog, toasts, empty states, skeletons, page header, error states; Vietnamese labels; accessible contrast/focus/keyboard; responsive.

Typed API layer for /api/v1: configurable base URL, typed contracts matching backend DTOs, standardized error parsing for 400/401/403/404/409/422/5xx, pagination helpers, TanStack Query key conventions; no invented endpoints or fields.
Module entry page shells exist for Historical Events, Lessons, Evidence/Assets, Templates and Versions with honest empty/coming-soon states; no fake CRUD.

Tests: unit/component tests for login validation, auth success/failure, expired session + refresh, unauthorized/learner-denied, logout, layout and navigation, API error parsing; at least one browser-level test Login -> Dashboard against a mocked/controlled backend; mocked tests are clearly labeled, not claimed as real backend E2E.
CI: GitHub Actions job lints, type-checks, tests and builds dau-viet-admin without breaking existing backend/mobile workflows.

Docs + harness: docs/admin-runbook.md (install, env vars, dev/test/build commands, auth flow, API base URL, known limitations, remaining modules); .env.example without secrets; .harness/config.json admin module active with real gates; task.json evidence complete; no P0/P1 security/auth/startup issues.
